{{Quote|Private Merghal, repeat subsection eight of article four-four-six of the Emergency Powers Act."<br />"Pssh, like I read any of that.|Rusk and Merghal|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Merghal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] criminal living during the [[Galactic War]]. As some point after the [[Eternal Empire conquest]], he was arrested by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and forcibly conscripted as a [[Private/Legends|Private]] into the [[Dead Man's Legion]], a unit of the [[Republic Army]] for men convicted of crime. In [[3631 BBY]] Dead Man's Legion was deployed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] under [[Provost Marshal]] [[Fideltin Rusk]]. Merghal tried to act tough in Rusk's presence, but was forced to back down after Rusk threatened him with a firing squad.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Merghal appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Rusk Alliance alert mission. He was voiced by [[Timothy Omundson]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
